Semeru: SIGMETs move the ash SE while VONAs say N/NE, 23-27 Sep 2026 (reconstructed)

caveats: The official product issued later is partly derived from the same VONA and satellite inputs, so it is not independent ground truth.
An Indonesian SIGMET copies the Darwin VAA, so 'official later' is effectively one voice.
Satellite retrievals miss coarse ash, and the official polygon has its own lag.
TEPHRA's zone is a decision margin that may only widen the official area, not a forecast of observed ash; Jaccard (CSI, FMS) against a later polygon is low by construction.
Ticks are sampled every step minutes, so an advisory that a later one replaced inside one step is not scored.
